lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，沙子让路
lines.en: I shuffle along, the sand gives way.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，一天挪一尺
lines.en: I go slowly, a foot a day.
The tide moves me faster than I walk.

lines.zh: 我拖着壳，沙上留一道沟
lines.en: I drag my shell, leaving a groove.

lines.zh: 挪到湿沙那边，水才好滤
lines.en: I shift to wet sand to filter better.
The shell is heavy, two steps and rest.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面，一点点前进
lines.en: I hug the sand and inch forward.
When the wave pulls back, I follow.
I stop where water covers my shell.

lines.zh: 我的路是弯的，没人看得懂
lines.en: My path curves, no one reads it.
Sand got in, every step grates.

lines.zh: 潮线一天挪两次，我跟着
lines.en: The tide line moves twice a day, I follow.

lines.zh: 我不用看，壳贴着地就知道
lines.en: No need to look, my shell reads the ground.

lines.zh: 再往前就是干沙，不去了
lines.en: Dry sand ahead, I go no further.

lines.zh: 沙从壳下滑走，我又挪了半寸
lines.en: Sand slips from under my shell, and I shift half an inch

lines.zh: 潮水退出一条路，我沿着走
lines.en: The tide leaves a path, and I take it
Shell closed, water slips through the seam.
I am filtering the fine food.
The cool under sand beats the surface.

lines.zh: 我这身花纹，是这片海给的
lines.en: These patterns were given by this sea.
The tide is not here, I wait.
A crab crawls past my shell.

lines.zh: 我把水管伸出去，又缩回
lines.en: I extend my siphon, then draw it back.
This sand covers half my shell.

lines.zh: 我和旁边的扇贝不同族
lines.en: I am not the same kind as that scallop.
Fainter patterns, whiter sand.

lines.zh: 有人踩过，沙子震了一下
lines.en: Someone walked by, the sand shook.
I open my shell only a few times a day.

lines.zh: 水浑的时候，我闭得最紧
lines.en: When water muddies, I shut tightest.
I have held this patch a long time.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的壳上
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell.

lines.zh: 你弯腰了，我看见你的手
lines.en: You bend down, I see your hands.
Barefoot on sand, your steps are heavy.
You look for the little bump.

lines.zh: 我壳上的花纹，是不是很像沙
lines.en: Do my patterns match the sand?
Your fingers test my shell's edge.
If I stay still, you miss me.
I know the net in your hand.
You look long and still do not reach.
I am shut, knocking is useless.
A white mark chipped my shell.
A small piece broke off my rim.

lines.zh: 有人把我从沙里拔出来
lines.en: Someone pulled me out of the sand.
My shell cracked, water pours in.
I shrink deep and still worry.
That knock leaves me dizzy.
A layer of my pattern is worn off.
Sand is in my flesh, it stings.
I am flipped belly up.
I cannot shut all the way.

lines.zh: 水里那点细末，往我这边来
lines.en: Those fine bits drift my way.
The crumbs you scatter, I take.
This murky water is rich.
I open a crack, only a crack.

lines.zh: 潮带来什么，我就吃什么
lines.en: Whatever the tide brings, I eat.

lines.zh: 你手上的盐味，我闻得到
lines.en: I taste the salt on your hands.
Closer, and I extend my siphon.

lines.zh: 我要的不是饵，是水里的绿
lines.en: Not bait, the green in the water.

lines.zh: 这片沙有味道，我留下了
lines.en: This sand has a taste, I stay.

lines.zh: 你把壳翻过来，我就露了
lines.en: Flip my shell and I am exposed.
Your toe touched my shell.
I am pressed half an inch into sand.
A wave pushed me onto stone.

lines.zh: 旁边的扇贝撞了我一下
lines.en: The scallop beside me bumped me.
The net dragged and scraped my rim.
You kick sand over me.
My shell knocked, a dull sound.
Do not pry me with your boot tip.
One surge rolls me half over.
Two clams wedged in one spot.
The water warms, time to release eggs.

lines.zh: 附近有同类在放，我跟着
lines.en: Others nearby spawn, I join.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，水会替我们碰头
lines.en: We stay apart, the water meets for us.

lines.zh: 这一片水里都是细小的白点
lines.en: The water fills with tiny white specks.

lines.zh: 谁离得近，谁的后代就多
lines.en: The nearest ones leave the most young.
The tide will carry them away.

lines.zh: 我只需张开壳，别的交给海
lines.en: I only open, the sea does the rest.
This season's water is just right.
Eggs released, I shut at once.
We never say farewell.

lines.zh: 一颗小石子滚进我壳里
lines.en: A pebble rolled into my shell.

lines.zh: 我用足慢慢把它推出去
lines.en: My foot slowly pushes it out.

lines.zh: 沙里有块碎的，我拾起来
lines.en: A fragment in the sand, I take it.
I pinch a blade of grass and hold.
This much will filter for a day.
Sand in my seam, I work it out.

lines.zh: 我捡到的，都会粘在壳上
lines.en: What I pick up clings to my shell.
This bright flake, I keep.
Too heavy, my shell will not close.
I bury it in the sand to keep.
Footsteps shake the sand this way.
The shadow in the water grows.
First I draw my siphon in.
I leave a sliver open and watch.
Those bare feet stop at my shell.
The net's shadow presses down.
Stones turning, closer now.
Someone stirs the shallows.
More than one came this time.
I pick one direction to flee.
Reach, and I close.
My rim faces your finger.
Each pry tightens me further.
I do not run, it would not help.
Sand beneath me, I dig down.
Do not knock, knocking shuts me tighter.
You switch hands, I still do not move.
The tide is coming, you should go.
I keep only one thin gap.
If you force it, you will get pinched.
My shell shuts on your finger.
My rim is thin and clamps hard.
You pull, I do not release.
This grip was practiced in sand.
I shut fast, you cannot dodge.
I clamp the net line and cut it.
You pry with a blade, I clamp harder.
My rim scrapes your hand.
I ease a hair, then shut again.
That one will stay with you.
I show a bit of shell from sand.

lines.zh: 这片滩是新到的，花纹不同
lines.en: New shore, new patterns on me.
The tide left me in shallows.
I settle on sand by the reef.
My shell still holds deep-sea cold.
My first act is to press into sand.

lines.zh: 巨蛤、扇贝、楔形贝，各有各的样子
lines.en: Giant, scallop, wedge, each has its shape.
Mine is blue with grey.
A wave hits and I shift half a foot.
Quiet here, good for growing shell.
My shell is baked hot.
I am dropped on hard stone.
I live in water and yet I smother.
A blast turns all the sand over.
An arrow wedges into my seam.
Light makes my shell translucent.
The water is too clear to filter.
Lightning hits the shore, sand jumps.
No sand below, I keep falling.
